title: Felvilágosult reformok: Urbárium és Ratio Educationis (Enlightenment Reforms)
grammar: Postpositions of Instrumentality (által, révén) and Enlightened Reforms

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name the Urbárium and the Ratio Educationis and say what each regulated.
I can use köteles and kötelezővé tesz to say what a decree required.
I can say that compulsory schooling was declared in Hungary only in 1868.
I can use eight new words about decrees and schools.
